positions.name: PallasineChecklistOnboarding
positions.frame: what does the Pallasine checklist cover as the onboarding process, and what did it replace?
positions.why: Both expressions describe the Pallasine checklist from complementary directions: src-1 covers its content and scope (first-week onboarding comprising accounts, pairing rotation, and a shadow shift), while src-2 covers its provenance (it replaced the old wiki page last quarter). The frame asks the question that both answers serve — what the checklist is and how it became the current standard.
